test_title: RRB NTPC - Graduate 2025 (CBT 2) Foundational Full Test - 09
subject: general
question: Which teams have won the Indian Premier League (IPL) title the most number of times?

options.text: Kolkata Knight Riders and Gujarat Titans
Chennai Super Kings and Mumbai Indians
Royal Challengers Bengaluru and Rajasthan Royals

solution:
The correct answer is __**Chennai Super Kings and Mumbai Indians.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **Mumbai Indians and Chennai Super Kings are the joint-most successful franchises in IPL history with five titles each.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **Mumbai Indians have won the IPL title five times – 2013, 2015, 2017, 2019 and 2020.**
 
• **Chennai Super Kings have also won the IPL title five times – 2010, 2011, 2018, 2021 and 2023.**
 
• Both franchises are jointly the most successful teams in IPL history with five championships each.
 
• Kolkata Knight Riders are the next most successful team with three IPL titles.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__
 
• **Mumbai Indians (MI)**__

 __
 
• Titles Won – 5
 
• Winning Years – 2013, 2015, 2017, 2019, 2020
 
• Home Ground – Wankhede Stadium, Mumbai
 
• One of the founding franchises of the IPL.
 
 
 
• **Chennai Super Kings (CSK)**__
 __
 
• Titles Won – 5
 
• Winning Years – 2010, 2011, 2018, 2021, 2023
 
• Home Ground – M. A. Chidambaram Stadium, Chennai
 
• Known for qualifying for the playoffs in a majority of seasons.
 
 
 
• **Kolkata Knight Riders (KKR)**__
 __
 
• Titles Won – 3
 
• Winning Years – 2012, 2014, 2024
 
• Third-most successful franchise in IPL history.
 
 
 
• **Other IPL Champions**__
 
 
• Royal Challengers Bengaluru – 1 title (2025)
 
• Gujarat Titans – 1 title (2022)
 
• Sunrisers Hyderabad – 1 title (2016)
 
• Rajasthan Royals – 1 title (2008)
 
• Deccan Chargers – 1 title (2009, franchise now defunct)
